observercam.config.title: Observer Cam Settings
observercam.config.category.title: Observer Cam — %s
observercam.config.live_hint: Changes apply live and save when you leave a page
observercam.config.pov.tooltip: Switch between your normal view and the camera on the Observer's observing face. You keep controlling your player.
observercam.config.recording.tooltip: Record your Observer while you continue playing normally or while viewing its POV. Recording begins only when the red LIVE message and timer appear.
observercam.config.pip.tooltip: Show or hide a small live view from your Observer while you continue using the normal player camera.
observercam.config.replay.save.tooltip: Save the footage currently retained by the optional instant replay buffer. F9 does the same thing.
observercam.config.reset.tooltip: Restore every Observer Cam setting to its recommended default.
observercam.config.reset.confirm.title: Reset Observer Cam settings?
observercam.config.reset.confirm.message: This restores every Observer Cam setting to its recommended default.
observercam.config.category.camera.toolt: Shot distance, framing height, and Observer POV field of view.
observercam.config.category.movement.too: How quickly and smoothly the cameraman moves and turns.
observercam.config.category.director.too: How the cameraman composes shots, holds stable framing, and follows its target.
observercam.config.category.recording.to: Visible output folder, storage protection, encoder, and optional game-audio source.
observercam.config.category.video.toolti: Recording format, output resolution, quality, frame rate, and HUD inclusion.
observercam.config.category.picture_in_p: Performance and refresh controls for the live Observer preview.
observercam.config.category.replay.toolt: Optional rolling footage that keeps only the recent time or size you choose.
observercam.config.category.debug.toolti: Optional diagnostics for testing and camera tuning.
observercam.config.setting.outdoor_dista: Preferred filming distance when the target has open space and sky around them.
observercam.config.setting.indoor_distan: Preferred filming distance inside buildings, caves, and other confined spaces.
observercam.config.setting.minimum_dista: Prevents normal shots from placing the Observer uncomfortably close to the player.
observercam.config.setting.maximum_dista: Prevents the Observer from selecting shots that are too far from the player.
observercam.config.setting.camera_height: Preferred elevation above the player's focus point when space permits.
observercam.config.setting.camera_fov.to: Field of view used only while looking through the Observer.
observercam.config.setting.maximum_speed: Fastest normal flight speed. Higher values catch the player sooner but can feel abrupt.
How quickly the cameraman changes velocity while moving toward a new shot.
observercam.config.setting.rotation_spee: Maximum yaw or pitch change per game tick.
observercam.config.setting.position_smoo: How strongly movement responds to the selected shot position.
observercam.config.setting.rotation_smoo: How strongly the Observer turns toward the player's framing point.
observercam.config.setting.catch_up_dist: Distance at which the director prioritizes catching up over holding the current shot.
observercam.config.setting.emergency_dis: Distance at which a safe emergency reposition is allowed after teleports or severe separation.
observercam.config.setting.background_im: How strongly the director favors camera angles with environmental depth behind the player.
observercam.config.setting.player_visibi: How heavily clear head-to-legs visibility influences candidate scoring.
observercam.config.setting.shot_stabilit: Higher values make the director more reluctant to abandon a usable current angle.
observercam.config.setting.reframe_thres: Minimum current-shot quality before the director considers the composition stable.
observercam.config.setting.player_screen: Approximate desired height of the player in the Observer POV frame.
observercam.config.setting.prediction_ti: How far ahead the director conservatively predicts a moving player's position.
observercam.config.setting.cameraman_ena: While connected to a world, On creates or resumes your Observer cameraman and Off dismisses it.
observercam.config.setting.follow_automa: When enabled, your Observer directs and follows its assigned target; turn it off to leave the camera parked.
observercam.config.setting.allow_front_s: Allows angles in front of the player's movement direction. Disable for mostly rear and side shots.
observercam.config.setting.recording_sto: Maximum combined space for Observer Cam-owned recordings and replay data. Unrelated files in a shared folder never count toward this cap.
observercam.config.setting.recording_out: Choose the folder where Observer Cam will save video files. Click to browse.
observercam.config.setting.open_recordin: Create the selected video folder if needed, then open it in your file manager.
observercam.config.setting.recording_vid: MP4 is the compatibility default, MKV is more resilient to interruption, and WebM uses the open VP9 codec.
observercam.config.setting.recording_fra: Target video and background Observer render rate, up to 120 FPS. Higher values are intended for powerful systems and greatly increase rendering and readback work.
observercam.config.setting.recording_inc: Applies while viewing Observer POV. Background Observer recordings stay clean so your normal player HUD is never mixed into them.
observercam.config.setting.picture_in_pi: A bounded live Observer preview, similar to an upgraded paper doll. It hides automatically while full Observer POV is active or the HUD is hidden. The local Observer's red eyes light while PiP is active.
Controls the actual secondary world-render size. Balanced is recommended; Ultra is optional and much more demanding.
How often the Observer preview renders, up to 60 FPS. 5 FPS is the recommended low-impact default.
observercam.config.setting.recording_ffm: Select ffmpeg.exe if FFmpeg is not available through your system PATH. Reset Defaults returns to automatic PATH detection.
observercam.config.setting.recording_aud: Off by default. Turn this on after choosing a game-audio loopback device; Observer Cam never selects a microphone automatically.
Choose a Windows game-audio loopback source such as Stereo Mix. Microphones are deliberately excluded from this list.
observercam.config.audio.instructions: Choose the Windows game-audio loopback source Observer Cam should record. Microphones are deliberately excluded.
observercam.config.audio.none_found: No game-audio loopback source is enabled in Windows. Recording will continue as video only.
observercam.config.audio.scan_failed: Observer Cam could not scan audio devices. Check the selected FFmpeg executable and try again.
observercam.config.audio.unsupported: Automatic audio-device selection is currently available on Windows.
observercam.config.setting.recording_res: Controls both the real background Observer render size and final output. 720p reduces gameplay impact; 1440p and 4K are optional high-end modes.
observercam.config.setting.recording_qua: High keeps more detail, Balanced is recommended, and Smaller Files uses stronger compression.
observercam.config.setting.instant_repla: Off by default. When On, your Observer buffers recent footage while you play normally or view its POV.
observercam.config.setting.save_instant_: Finalize the retained rolling footage as a normal video, then resume buffering automatically.
observercam.config.setting.instant_repla: Choose whether the rolling replay buffer evicts old footage by elapsed time or disk size.
How many recent minutes the instant replay buffer retains before evicting its oldest complete segments.
Maximum temporary replay footage to retain. It can never exceed the overall recording storage cap.
observercam.config.setting.debug_hud.too: Shows the director state, target, score, visibility, distance, and movement data while in Observer POV.
observercam.config.setting.show_candidat: Marks evaluated camera positions with lightweight colored particles.
observercam.config.setting.show_rays.too: Draws the selected camera-to-target line used during framing checks.
observercam.config.setting.show_selected: Highlights the director's chosen camera destination.
observercam.config.setting.show_collisio: Marks candidate positions rejected because the Observer would intersect blocks.
